title: One episode replayed: research U-bolt fatigue data and condense it to one page

events.label: State the task
events.detail: 「帮我查 U 型螺栓的疲劳数据，整理成一页摘要。」Two subtasks hide inside this one sentence: retrieval (where to look, what to look for) and summarization (which data deserves the page). The plan is not in the prompt — the agent comes up with it inside the loop.

events.label: Round 1 begins: read the task and the tool list
events.detail: Besides the role setting, the system prompt carries the tool list (search / fetch) and the stopping condition. The agent's first move is to break the task into a retrieval plan — note that the web API is not on the tool list; it is reachable only through the fetch tool.

events.label: Thinking call #1: produce a retrieval plan
events.detail: An ordinary chat call whose output is not an answer but an action decision: search the standards-manual site and the vendor catalogs first. Every thinking round is an independent model call; context accumulates round by round.

events.label: Action: search("U型螺栓 疲劳")
events.detail: The model emits a structured call (function name + argument JSON); the client validates the arguments and actually executes. The model never browses on its own — it only 「requests calls」; execution lives on the client.

events.label: Observation: 5 hits
events.detail: 3 standards manuals and 2 vendor catalogs, one of them a 2019 legacy catalog. The observation returns to the context in full, ready for the next round of thinking — this is where the context starts to swell.

events.label: Thinking call #2: triage and revise
events.detail: Two judgments: the legacy catalog's data cannot be cited directly (timeliness); after two searches, one duty-condition data sheet is still missing. Revised plan: fetch the current catalog page first, summarize once the data is sufficient.

events.label: Action: fetch(current catalog URL)
events.detail: The client performs the HTTP GET. Timeout and retry policy are client-side engineering the model never sees — it only ever receives a successful result or an error observation.

events.label: Observation: load-life curve and measured points
events.detail: The current catalog contains the U-bolt load-life curve and measured fatigue data for two duty conditions. The data now covers the task requirements; move into summarization.

events.label: Thinking call #3: summary structure
events.detail: Decide the summary structure (duty-condition comparison → data table → gaps and recommendations), drop the legacy catalog data, and record the reason — 「dropping with a stated reason」 is the quality key. The data suffices; the final answer can be produced.

events.label: Final answer: a one-page summary
events.detail: The same round produces the final reply directly (it could also be split into a separate 「generation」 call — a design trade-off). The content carries the conclusion table, a source citation for every number, and the data-gap notes.

events.label: Wrap-up: archive citations and by-products
events.detail: The loop's intermediate artifacts — the hit list, the dropped legacy catalog — are archived as by-products for human review of the episode's trustworthiness. Auditability is the engineering value that separates agents from single calls.

events.label: Deliver: summary + evidence chain
events.detail: The user receives not just an answer but the evidence chain for why it is trustworthy. Contrast with E01: there one request is a straight line; here there are many rounds, autonomous decisions, and an audit trail.

events.label: Loop exit: stopping condition met
events.detail: Retrieval plan completed + final answer produced — the stopping condition fires and the loop ends. Without one (a round cap, a task-completion check), the loop would spin forever — the reason guardrails exist, expanded in A07's runaway experiment.
